mentions.name: PaperWX
mentions.description: A dead-simple weather site that shows the next 24 hours of weather in plain language and emails the forecast the night before, using information freely available from local NWS.
mentions.problem: Most weather sites are horrible to read, even though the underlying information is freely available from local NWS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A few months ago I was looking to create a dead simple weather site that would show me the next 24 hours in plain language and email me the night before. Most weather sites are horrible to read and most of this information is freely available by your local NWS.

https://paperwx.com/
